usedFor: Zoho Expense manages business spending, and “Create a Trip”, “Create Expense Categories” and “Update Project” set up what gets tracked.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a Trip” in Zoho Expense
bestTemplate.why: It records a trip with destination, attendees, budget and currency.

watchOut: “Make Project Active” and “Make Project Inactive” need a Project ID, so have it ready.
